name: omnibase/video
description: A video platform on omnibase: videos and channels, resumable uploads through tusd, HLS transcoding with ffmpeg, a player that keeps playing across pages, views, likes, timed comments, playlists, subscriptions, reports, a members' studio, local suggestions (Gorse optional) and a Typesense index.

suggest.ffmpeg: The ffmpeg and ffprobe binaries on the worker transcode the uploads (HLS fMP4, poster, storyboard).
suggest.tusproject/tusd: The resumable upload server the studio sends files to (docs/upload.md).
suggest.gorse-io/gorse: gorse-in-one, an optional recommender (video.suggest.provider: gorse); the local suggestions stay when it is down.
